items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I know Wendell Marshall was his cousin. Is Wendell Marshall still alive?

ctx.x: Who and what was his inspiration? Did he just suddenly conceive of the bass as being an instrument that should and could be played differently than anyone had ever played it before? Or what?
I think he had started on the violin; I'm not sure. I know Wendell Marshall was his cousin. Is Wendell Marshall still alive?
Yes, Wendell is living in St. Louis, but he's not playing any more.
